description: Internal utility functions and classes for PyTorch testing, including dtype dispatching, device handling, and NumPy wrappers.

classes.name: _dynamic_dispatch_dtypes
classes.description: Subclass of _dispatch_dtypes to tag dynamically generated types.

methods.name: get_supported_dtypes
methods.description: Returns supported data types for a given operator and device type, using sample inputs.

methods.name: dtypes_dispatch_hint
methods.description: Selects appropriate dtype dispatch function based on provided dtypes.

methods.name: is_dynamic_dtype_set
methods.description: Checks if an OpInfo entry acquires dtypes dynamically.

methods.name: str_format_dynamic_dtype
methods.description: Formats a string describing an OpInfo's dtype dispatch configuration.

methods.name: np_unary_ufunc_integer_promotion_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps a NumPy unary ufunc to promote integer inputs to PyTorch's default dtype.

methods.name: reference_reduction_numpy
methods.description: Wraps a NumPy reduction operator, forwarding dim, keepdim, mask, and identity kwargs.

methods.name: prod_numpy
methods.description: Performs np.prod with dtype adjustments to prevent integer overflow issues.
